title: •No Escape
caption: •No Escape (V)
game_text: Plays on table. At opponent’s ◇ site where opponent’s creature present, you may deploy without presence or Force icons, and your Force generation there is +1.
lore: Jabba’s influence is not easily ignored. Neither are his voracious and vile appetites. Even Jedi soon learn this lesson.

notes: Unique. Banner DEFENSIVE SHIELD (slip frame: red Effect top edge fading into the teal shield frame). Printed base is a Jabba's Palace Sealed Deck Effect. No grabber box. Slip heading and caption both •; match the base. White diamond (non-unique-location mark) before 'site' typed as ◇ (U+25C7); the wiki stub reads it as 'system site' and the PDF text layer drops it — otherwise identical to the stub. Lore wording matches the wiki; curly apostrophe in Jabba’s (wiki straight; 350 px scan, also on the VSh remake). COPYRIGHT: the 350 px scan reads '© LUCASFILM LTD. & TM. TM, ® & © 2000 DECIPHER INC.' (Jabba's Palace Sealed Deck was released 2000), NOT the 1998 Hoth-style line the brief suggested — used what the scan prints (same as the earlier JPSD card in this repo). Modern: VSh-D-noescape-pre.gif (350 px). Art from the base scan, not the modern VSh shield face: the shield frame's art window is narrower and left a cyan strip down the right edge of the art box.
